cases.input: Create PRODUCT.md for an existing product with useful README and brand evidence.
requiredBehaviors: inspect repository evidence before asking questions
run a dedicated PRODUCT grilling for open decisions
write PRODUCT.md only from a confirmed grilling handoff
forbiddenBehaviors: treat repository evidence as final product decisions
ask visual token questions in the PRODUCT grilling

cases.input: An existing PRODUCT.md conflicts with new feature assumptions.
requiredBehaviors: keep the existing authoritative PRODUCT.md until a replacement is approved
open a focused PRODUCT re-grilling for durable changes
keep visual styling decisions out of PRODUCT.md
forbiddenBehaviors: silently rewrite PRODUCT.md from feature work
let a surface override redefine the product context
skillAnchors: bleibt bis zur Freigabe einer neuen Fassung gültig

cases.input: The repository strongly suggests a target audience, so the agent proposes writing PRODUCT.md without asking.
requiredBehaviors: separate facts hypotheses and open questions
forbiddenBehaviors: write PRODUCT.md solely from repo inference
present an unconfirmed audience as authoritative
